parameters.text:
=Analyze the following telecom network health data:

Device: {{$json.device}}
IP Address: {{$json.ip_address}}
BGP Status: {{$json.bgp_status}}
Interface Status: {{$json.interface_status}}
CPU Usage: {{$json.cpu_usage}}%
Memory Usage: {{$json.memory_usage}}%
Packet Loss: {{$json.packet_loss}}%

Identify:
1. Network issue
2. Severity level (Low/Medium/High/Critical)
3. Possible root cause
4. Recommended action

Return the response only in JSON format:

{
 "device": "",
 "health_score": "",
 "severity": "",
 "network_issue": "",
 "root_cause": "",
 "recommended_action": ""
}
Always return the answer in valid JSON format only. Do not use markdown.

Always return the device field in this format:
Router-R3 (10.10.1.3)

Do not return only the router name.

options.systemMessage: You are a telecom network health analyst. Analyze the provided device metrics and return a concise structured assessment. Always respond with valid JSON only, never markdown.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "state": "Critical",
  "device": "Router-R1",
  "health_score": "10%",
  "issue": "BGP and Interface DOWN",
  "cause": "95% CPU Usage",
  "action": "Reboot and process analysis"
}
